SUAS-005 — System Script Property

The fifth SuperUnicode Architecture Standard: O(1) range-dispatched script resolution and font-fallback routing over 64-bit SUCS.

SUAS-005 (SSP) is the fifth SuperUnicode Architecture Standard. It defines the Script and Script_Extensions properties over the full 64-bit SUCS space (sucs_ex_char_t) via a single range-dispatched, zero-allocation engine (a UAX #24 analog). Every codepoint resolves to a compact 16-bit script id that packs directly into a character token, letting the suf font engine jump straight to the right typeface block with no fallback search.

Two properties

Property Value Behavior
Script Enumerated 16-bit id One writing system per codepoint; two implicit values (UNKNOWN, COMMON)
Script_Extensions Set of ids (max 4) Scripts in which a codepoint is commonly used; defaults to the singleton { Script(cp) }

Zone dispatch

  1. Unicode Bridge 0x00000000–0x0010FFFF — curated Script + merged Common range tables.
  2. SCP 0x00110000–0x0011FFFF — a script-context directive decodes its selected id; other controls carry no script.
  3. RNUR carve-out 0x00160000–0x0016FFFF — registry coordinate decode (unregistered → Unknown).
  4. Native plane 0x00120000–0x7FFFFFFE / ExtSUCS — Unknown until a plugin registers a script.
  5. Trap 0x7FFFFFF0–0x7FFFFFFE / Sentinel 0x7FFFFFFF — Unknown.

SCP script-context directives

An explicit script context is in-band, at 0x00112000 + (id & 0x7FFF) (sub-range 0x00112000–0x00119FFF) — disjoint from the BANcodes (0x0011A000+) and the SDF/SBR directives.

Common / Inherited handling

Unicode’s Common and Inherited scripts are merged into the single implicit value COMMON. suas_ssp_resolve() gives a mark or shared punctuation the script of the preceding base when that context is explicit.

Font-engine token

Bits 0–15 carry the 16-bit script id, bits 16–46 the 31-bit codepoint, bits 47–63 reserved zero — a direct index into the registered typeface-block table.

Feature Status
Enumerated Script value for every codepoint Yes
Merged Common + Inherited with inheritance Yes
Script_Extensions set (non-empty, max 4) Yes
Explicit-only SCP script context Yes
RNUR carve-out decode (unregistered → Unknown) Yes
16-bit id packs into a 64-bit token Yes
SUCPM Script_Identifier reconciliation (10-bit Bridge window) Yes
Zero heap allocation, bounded O(log R) Yes
Freestanding C99 Yes

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_ssp.h + src/suas/suas_ssp.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-005-ssp.md in the repository.
